title: Stacks
description: Declarative resource sets with a revision history you can diff, pin and roll back.

empty.title: No stacks yet
empty.description: Apply a manifest to a stack from the CLI and it appears here with its revisions.

detail.pinnedBanner: Pinned to revision {{revision}}. New applies are refused until it is unpinned.

revision.title: Revision {{number}}
revision.noFiles: No files stored for this revision.

rollback.title: Roll back to revision {{number}}?
rollback.description: This applies the files of revision {{number}} to {{name}} as a new revision.
rollback.secretsNote: Secrets are not rolled back. Current secret values stay as they are.
rollback.dataNote: Data is not rolled back. Databases and volumes keep their current contents.
rollback.pendingApproval: Revision {{number}} is awaiting approval. Nothing was rolled back yet.

delete.title: Delete stack {{name}}?
delete.description: Choose what happens to the resources the stack manages.
delete.forgetHint: Remove the stack and its history. Resources keep running unmanaged.
delete.destroyHint: Delete the apps and databases the stack manages, then the stack.

settings.title: Stack settings
settings.allowPruneHint: Let an apply delete resources that left the manifest.
settings.requireApprovalHint: Applies wait for a person to approve them.
settings.driftHint: Lock stops applies while live state differs from the stack.
settings.rootOnly: Only an admin can change these.

managedNotice.warn: Managed by stack {{name}}. Manual changes may be reverted or reported as drift.
managedNotice.lock: Managed by stack {{name}}, which locks its resources. Manual changes may be refused or reverted.

drift.title: Drift: {{count}} resources differ from the stack
drift.noValues: Only field paths are shown. Values are never stored.

approval.approveDescription: This applies the stored plan to {{name}}. Another admin requested it.
approval.secretsNote: Secrets are never stored. Supply any the manifest needs now; they are sent once and not kept.
approval.stale: The plan changed since it was reviewed. Request approval again.
approval.expired: This approval request expired. Request approval again.
approval.rejectDescription: Nothing is applied to {{name}} and the request is closed.
